A1.justification: Both complete 42-page PDFs describe SIMPLER and support comparison of text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G. Pages 12–42, including all supplementary material, have identical text and rendered content.

before.justification: v2 reports original performance and efficiency experiments on MADOS, BigEarthNetv2, Sen4Map and CIFAR-100, together with ablations, SAR classification and embedded-device measurements.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Tables 2–7 and the appendices, including the SAR and Jetson Orin experiments in Appendix G.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Algorithm S1 retain the same representation extraction, similarity computation, cutoff scoring, layer selection and fine-tuning procedures, including combination with LoRA.

E1.justification: The same datasets, tasks, modalities and deployment scenarios are evaluated. The BigEarthNetv2 and Sen4Map wording changes clarify task descriptions; the corresponding experiments in Tables 3–4 and Appendix F remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged within corresponding experiments: full fine-tuning, LoRA, post-hoc pruning where evaluated, and LayerDrop combinations in Table S14.

E3.justification: The 500-sample similarity protocol, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, preprocessing and hardware settings remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendix F.

E4.justification: The sample-size, similarity-metric, pre-training, noise, linear-probing and block-selection analyses are retained. Non-MAE scope analyses and qualitative segmentation examples in the appendices are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, five-run disclosures and seeds 42–46 specified in Appendix F. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains MADOS mIoU of 62.8±1.2 for SIMPLER versus 66.9±2.5 for the full 300M baseline; appendix result tables are identical.

T1.justification: The cutoff optimization, variability definitions and similarity formulas remain identical in Equations 1–2 and S1–S3 and Algorithm S1. Equation 2 moves from page 6 to page 5 without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about depth selection before fine-tuning, efficiency-performance trade-offs and generalization. The task-description edits do not redefine the core contributions.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, performance trade-offs and applicability limitations remain unchanged, including reliance on deep-layer stabilization and the scope boundary illustrated by the non-MAE models in Appendix C.

D1.justification: The code-access statement and implementation disclosures are retained, including hardware, optimizer, LoRA settings, data loading, training schedules and CPU/RAM pre-analysis costs in Appendix F.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, all 49 references and positioning relative to PEFT, post-hoc pruning and adaptive-depth methods remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction removes 'crop mapping' from the BigEarthNetv2 description. Sections 4.1 and 4.3 replace Sen4Map's 'crop type mapping' with 'land-cover classification'. These are limited terminology edits; section order and the broader narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Spacing and page breaks change across early pages: Table 1 shifts upward, and the Methodology heading and Equation 2 move to preceding pages. Figure 1a also has a minor punctuation edit. Figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Removing crop-specific wording for BigEarthNetv2 and describing Sen4Map as land-cover classification makes the task descriptions more consistent with the retained classification evaluations. This provides a modest clarity improvement; the methods, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
